It asserts 'the dependency cone (lines 135-245) contains no sorry or oops' and that 'every oops in the file lies outside this range', listing oops at 163, 171, 180, 186, 200 among the outside lines - but those five lines are inside 135-245 (grep confirms oops at exactly 67,82,90,127,132,163,171,180,186,200,251,287,292,321,328,344,371,384,388,419,450,484). The oops at 160-200 are unrelated reify demo lemmas, not linum's cone, so the underlying fact (linum's real cone is sorry/oops-free) is true, but the claim's line-range statement is false and self-contradictory. Fix: reword claim 2 to name linum's actual dependency cone (num L137-138, Inum L152-158, lin_add L205-223, lin_mul L225-233, linum L235-245) as sorry/oops-free, and correctly state that the file's oops (including 163,171,180,186,200, which sit between those ranges) are in the unrelated reify/demo lemmas.

Move is stated to generalise beyond linum: applicability.goal_shape gives the parametric template 'I (f t) bs = I t bs' over a fun/primrec recursion f on a reflected datatype with interpretation I, and also_known_as plus claim 4 (known-use at nnf L121 and linaform L315-316, the latter reusing linum as a leaf) show the same induction-over-reflected-datatype move recurring, so it is not tied to this example. 'when not to use' is honest and specific: avoid when helpers depend on each other or the main theorem (breaks the acyclic depth-1 graph), when a helper is single-use and trivial (inline it), or when a case needs a parameter fixed (state an explicit arbitrary:). Consequences are specific and trace to the code: one obligation per helper or simp_all stalls; bs must be generalised over the induction (fixing it breaks recursive cases); the CN case needs both helpers because linum recurses through a Mul inside an Add; each helper must state exactly the rewrite simp_all needs. The README states what makes the children good leaves for a bounded prover: each is self-contained with a free environment list, closes without naming any further project lemma (own f.induct + case_tac + algebra_simps/Let_def), and the helper graph is acyclic at depth 1.
